items.headline: IFSC Distributors ab UAE, Singapore, Australia, EU mein bhi allowed
items.what: IFSCA ne apne Master Circular ko amend kiya hai. Ab IFSC Distributors ko UAE, Singapore, Australia aur European Union mein distribution activity ki ijazat milegi.
items.who: Jo bhi IFSC mein registered distributors hain, aur ye countries/jurisdictions target karte hain.
items.action: Agar aap IFSC distributor ho to apna list update karo. Ye naye jurisdiction mil gaye hain, compliance check karo.

items.headline: FPIs ke liye certified KYC copy facility RBI ne badhai
items.what: RBI ne sabhi co-operative banks (rural, urban aur regional rural banks), Local Area Banks aur Small Finance Banks ko bola hai ki woh FPIs se KYC documents certified copy ke roop mein accept kar sakte hain. Certified copy yaani FPI apne documents ko kuch specified foreign authority se attest karwa sakte hain.
items.who: Ye rule Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) par lagu hai jo India mein co-operative, local area ya small finance banks ke through invest karte hain.
items.action: Agar aap FPI client handle karte ho, toh KYC document certification process check karo. Client ko certified copy ka process samjha do, aur kis authority se certification chahiye, ye clarify karo.

items.headline: PIT compliance par directors aur KMPs ko kya jaanna hai
items.what: SEBI ne PIT (Prohibition of Insider Trading) compliance ko lekar listed companies ke directors aur KMPs ke liye guide banayi hai. Isme UPSI, trading window, disclosure aur SDD jaisi cheezein cover ki gayi hain.
items.who: Listed company ke directors, KMPs aur compliance team.
items.action: Apne company ka SEBI PIT compliance policy dobara check karo. Recent amendments ya guide points implement kiye hain ya nahi, verify karo.

items.headline: Directors aur KMPs ke liye PIT Compliance guide
items.what: Listed companies ke liye SEBI ki PIT (Prohibition of Insider Trading) compliance ka practical overview diya gaya hai. Insider trading, UPSI, trading windows, disclosures aur latest amendments cover kiye gaye hain.
items.who: Sirf listed companies ke directors, key managerial personnel (KMP) aur compliance teams par lagu hai.
items.action: Directors aur KMPs ko PIT policy, trading window aur disclosures ka compliance review karna chahiye. SEBI amendments ko apne internal process mein update karo.

items.headline: RBI: FPIs ke liye KYC certified copy facility extended
items.what: RBI ne banks ko allow kiya hai ki woh Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) ke KYC documents certified copies ke roop mein specified overseas authorities se accept kar sakte hain. Ye facility ab cooperative banks, regional rural banks, local area banks aur small finance banks par bhi lagu hai.
items.who: Sabhi banks, co-operative banks, regional rural banks, local area banks, small finance banks aur FPIs par lagu hai.
items.action: Agar aap ek FPI hain ya bank mein FPI client serve karte hain, toh certified KYC copies submit/accept kar sakte hain. KYC document certification aur nayi process ka use karein.

items.headline: LLP Annual Form 8 aur Form 11 filing ka rule
items.what: LLP ko har saal Form 8 aur Form 11 file karna hota hai. Isme partner details, contribution, financial statements aur solvency ki details jati hai.
items.who: Sabhi Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) par lagu hai.
items.action: Jo bhi LLP run kar rahe hain, apni annual Form 8 aur Form 11 timely file karein. Required financial aur partner info ready rakhein.

items.headline: UPI par aam aadmi ko charge nahi lagega
items.what: UPI se P2P yani aadmi se aadmi aur 96% merchant transactions par koi charge nahi hai. Sirf kuch particular transactions par ₹2,000 ke upar MDR lagega.
items.who: Sabhi UPI users aur wo merchants jo digital payment accept karte hain.
items.action: UPI se payment nishchint hokar karein. Agar aap merchant hain to apne payment provider se puchhein ki aapke liye MDR लागू hota hai ya nahi.

items.headline: Company Secretary ki role ab aur important hai DPDP compliance mein
items.what: Company Secretaries ab DPDP compliance, board ki oversight, cyber incident ki report aur SEBI ki disclosure rules mein help karenge.
items.who: Listed companies ya jinke upar SEBI ki LODR rules lagte hain.
items.action: Board aur compliance teams apne Company Secretary se DPDP aur cybersecurity policy ki review karwain. Nai disclosure requirements samjhein.

items.headline: Chhote NBFCs ko registration se exemption mil sakta hai
items.what: Aise NBFCs jo low risk hain aur systemic risk nahi create karte, unko RBI kehta hai ki strict conditions par registration ki zarurat nahi.
items.who: Unregistered Type I NBFCs ya bouquet NBFCs jo chhote scale par kaam kar rahe hain.
items.action: Agar aap chhote NBFC operator hain to RBI ke latest guidelines padhein aur check karein ki kya aapka NBFC exemption ke criteria mein aata hai ya nahi.

items.headline: IFSCA Fund Management Rules mein naye changes aaye hain
items.what: IFSCA ne Fund Management Second Amendment Regulations, 2026 notify kiye. Isme valuation, FME contribution, investor protection aur disclosure rules mein changes hai.
items.who: FME, fund managers aur entities jo IFSC Gift City mein scheme operate karte hain.
items.action: Fund managers aur compliance professionals amendment ka text padhein. Apni compliance process update karein.

items.headline: ARC par RBI ke naye FAQs jaari hue
items.what: RBI ne Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARC) par FAQ jaari kiya hai. Isme ARCs ke permissible activities, restructuring, outsourcing aur KYC jaise topics cover hain.
items.who: ARCs aur unke compliance/advisory teams.
items.action: ARC operators apne practices ko FAQs ke hisaab se review karein. Naye KYC aur management fee rules samjhein.

items.headline: UPI par P2P payments free hi rahenge
items.what: UPI se P2P yaani aadmi se aadmi ki payment free hai. Lagbhag 96% merchant transactions par bhi charge nahi lagega. Kuch select merchant payments par hi charge lagega, wo bhi ₹2,000 ke upar ke transactions par.
items.who: UPI users aur merchant jo UPI accept karte hain.
items.action: Agar aap UPI use kar rahe hain to chinta ki baat nahi. Merchant ho to check karo ki aapke par kaunse payments par charge lag sakta hai.

items.headline: Chhote NBFCs ko registration se chhut, magar shartein hain
items.what: RBI ne bataya hai ki jo chhote aur low-risk NBFCs hain (jinpar systemic risk nahi hai), unko registration ki zaroorat nahi, ek nayi category 'Unregistered Type I NBFCs' ke liye. Magar kuch strict conditions hain.
items.who: Low-risk, chhote NBFCs jinpar systemic risk nahi hai.
items.action: Agar aap chhota NBFC chalate hain to dekhiye kya aap in sharton mein aate ho. Registration karne se pehle latest RBI guidelines padh lo.

items.headline: Company Secretary ka role DPDP compliance aur cybersecurity mein
items.what: Company Secretary DPDP Act ki compliance, Board ko report dena, cybersecurity incident assess karna, aur SEBI disclosures coordinate karne mein help kar sakta hai.
items.who: Listed companies aur jinpar SEBI LODR lagu hai.
items.action: Agar aap listed company ho to Company Secretary ko DPDP aur cybersecurity policy banane mein shamil karo. Disclosures time par file karo.

items.headline: IPO mein DRHP kya hota hai? Kya-kya disclose karna hota hai?
items.what: Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) IPO ka main document hai. Ismein company ki financial, legal aur auditor related info disclose karni hoti hai, draft filing se final prospectus tak pura process hota hai.
items.who: Jo companies IPO lane ki soch rahi hain.
items.action: Agar IPO ka plan hai to DRHP ki legal aur auditor requirements dhyan se follow karo. Saari disclosures sahi daton ke sath file karo.

items.headline: IFSCA Fund Management Rules mein nayi badlaav aaye
items.what: IFSCA ne fund management ki guidelines mein 2026 mein kuch badlaav kiye hain. Ismein valuation, FME contribution, investor protection, disclosures, aur scheme governance ko update kiya gaya hai.
items.who: Funds ya asset management companies jo IFSCA ke under registered hain.
items.action: Agar aap IFSCA ke under fund manage kar rahe ho to nayi amendments padh lo aur compliance ka plan bana lo.

items.headline: ARC ke rules par RBI ka naya FAQ aaya hai
items.what: RBI ne 11 September 2026 ko ARC (Asset Reconstruction Companies) ke rules pe FAQs issue kiye hain. Ismein regulations, activities, security receipts, restructuring, outsourcing, management fees aur KYC ki info di gayi hai.
items.who: ARC chalane wale aur unse deal karne wale log/companies.
items.action: Agar ARC mein kaam karte ho to RBI ka latest FAQ padh lo. Compliance ki checklist bana lo, nayi updates check karo.

items.headline: UPI par P2P aur zyada transactions ab bhi free hain
items.what: Sarkar ne clarify kiya hai ki UPI par person to person (P2P) transactions free rahenge. 96% merchant transactions bhi bina kisi charge ke hain. Sirf kuch bade payments (specified payments above ₹2,000) par MDR lagega.
items.who: UPI use karne wale sabhi log aur chhote-mote merchants par lagu hai.
items.action: Agar aap UPI istemal karte hain to aapko charge nahi dena. Merchant ho to check karo aapke transactions par MDR lag raha hai ya nahi. Zyada clarify ke liye Finance Ministry ki clarification padh lo.

items.headline: IFSCA Fund Management mein naye amendments aaye
items.what: IFSCA ne Fund Management Regulations mein doosra amendment kiya hai. Isme valuation, FME ki contribution, investor protection, disclosures aur scheme governance par changes hain.
items.who: Jo entities IFSCA ke under fund management ka kaam karti hain un par lagu hai.
items.action: Aapko nayi regulations check karni chahiye. Apne fund documents update karo aur investor ko naye disclosure do.

items.headline: Chhote unregistered NBFCs ke liye kuch exemption mili
items.what: RBI ne kuch chhote NBFCs ko registration ki requirement se exempt kiya hai, lekin sirf jo low-risk hain. Inhe "Unregistered Type I NBFCs" bolte hain. Par kuch sakht shartein bhi hain.
items.who: Woh NBFCs jinpe systemic risk nahi hai aur jo chhoti size ki hain.
items.action: Agar aap NBFC run karte hain to dekho aap is exemption mein aate ho ya nahi. Exemption ki terms carefully padh ke comply karo.

items.headline: RBI FAQs: ARCs kaun hai aur kya kar sakte hain?
items.what: RBI ne FAQs jari kiye hain jisme Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARCs) se judi kaafi clarity di gayi hai. Isme investment rules, KYC, restructuring, aur management fees wagairah cover hain.
items.who: Asset Reconstruction Companies (ARCs) aur unse judne wale NBFCs ya professionals.
items.action: Agar aap ARC operate karte hain ya waha serve karte hain, to RBI ki FAQs ko dhyan se padhkar apne compliance aur documentation ka review karein.

items.headline: Priority Sector Lending ke ANBC exemption ki cut-off badli
items.what: RBI ne Priority Sector Lending directions amend kiye hain. FCNR (B) aur NRE deposit-backed advances ko ANBC se exclude karne ki cut-off date ab 31 August 2026 ho gayi hai, pehle 30 September 2026 thi.
items.who: Wo banks jo FCNR (B) ya NRE deposits ke against advance dete hain.
items.action: Banks apni ANBC calculation aur compliance check kar lein. Naye cut-off ko dhyan me rakhte hue reporting karein.

items.headline: CRCS-Sahara Refund Portal dobara chalu, claims process resume
items.what: Ministry ne CRCS-Sahara Refund Portal phir se activate kiya hai. Ab genuine depositors apna claim digital process se daal sakte hain, verification bhi continue ho rahi hai.
items.who: Sahara par paisa jama karne wale original depositors jin ka claim pending tha.
items.action: Sahara refund claim ab portal par dobara daal sakte hain. Aadhaar ready rakhein aur online verification complete karein.

items.headline: RBI FAQs: Priority Sector Lending rules par naya samjhauta
items.what: RBI ke naye FAQs mein priority sector lending ki classification, calculation, agriculture, housing jaise sectors cover kiye hain. Securitised assets aur PSLC trading par bhi guideline hai.
items.who: Banks aur lenders jo priority sector (kheti, education, housing, etc.) mein loan dete hain.
items.action: Compliance team nayi FAQs ka study karein. Apne internal process, classification aur targets ki calculation ko update karein.

items.headline: 18 mahine pehle DRHP filing ka practical guide aaya
items.what: Ek guide jari hui hai jisme bataya hai ki IPO se 18 mahine pehle kaunse controls, governance steps, FEMA compliance aur audit/Ind AS ki taiyari zaruri hai.
items.who: Woh companies jo IPO laane ka plan kar rahi hain, aur unke promoters & advisors.
items.action: IPO planning team apni process, documentation aur compliances guide ke hisaab se review karein. DRHP filing se kaafi pehle ka preparation check karein.

items.headline: Priority Sector Lending mein kuch advances ab ANBC se bahar
items.what: RBI ne clarify kiya hai ki kuch specific FCNR(B) aur NRE term deposit ke against diye gaye advances, kuch dinon ke liye, ANBC (Adjusted Net Bank Credit) calculation se bahar rahenge. Ye sirf deposits ke renewal/maturity ki specific dates ke beech apply hoga.
items.who: Sabhi banks jinmein FCNR(B) ya NRE deposit hain aur jo ANBC calculation karte hain.
items.action: Aapke bank ko check karna chahiye ki aapke advances ka calculation sahi ho, especially agar FCNR(B) ya NRE deposits ke against advance diya gaya hai. Bank compliance team is change ko apne PSL calculation process mein update karein.

items.headline: RBI ne ARC se judi FAQs issue ki, roles clear kiye
items.what: RBI ne asset reconstruction companies (ARC) ke operations par FAQs release kiye hain. Isme clarify kiya gaya hai ki ARC kya activity kar sakte hain, NBFC ke taur par unka role kya hai, KYC aur servicing arrangements kaise honge.
items.who: Asset reconstruction companies (ARC), unse deal karne wale bankers aur professionals.
items.action: Jo bhi ARC sector mein kaam kar rahe hain, RBI ki latest FAQs ko dhyan se padhein, compliance aur activity planning accordingly karein.

items.headline: Priority Sector Lending pe FAQs jari, classification clarify hua
items.what: RBI ne Priority Sector Lending guidelines par FAQs publish kiye hain. Isme explain kiya gaya hai ki kaunse loans PSL maanenge, calculation kaise hogi, aur agriculture, education, housing waale sectors mein kya rules lagenge.
items.who: Banks, NBFCs, aur jo log PSL compliance ya reporting mein jude hain.
items.action: PSL se jude professionals apne institution ke lending products ko is latest clarification se match kar lein. FAQs zaroor padhein, compliance gap check karein.

items.headline: Sahara refund portal fir se chalu, claims process resume hua
items.what: Ministry ne CRCS-Sahara Refund Portal ko wapas chalu kiya hai. Ab genuine depositors apne claim online, Aadhaar ke through verify kara sakte hain. Pending refund ab process kiye jayenge.
items.who: Wo depositors jinhone Sahara/CRCS mein paisa jama kiya tha aur abhi unka refund pending hai.
items.action: Aise depositors ko portal par login kar ke apna claim wapas file/verify karna chahiye. Aadhaar aur related documents ready rakhein.

items.headline: SEBI ne mutual fund settlement propose kiya
items.what: SEBI ne mutual funds ke cash market transactions ke liye net settlement ka proposal manga hai. Abhi outright trades par fund obligations ko net settle karne ka idea hai, lekin securities ki settlement gross hi hogi.
items.who: Yeh proposal mutual funds houses aur unke transaction handling teams ke liye hai.
items.action: Aap mutual fund compliance ya settlement department se discuss karein. Agar aap suggestion dena chahte hain to apni industry body ya direct SEBI portal par response bhej sakte hain.

items.headline: GIFT IFSC ne foreign currency mobilisation highlight kiya
items.what: IFSCA ne bataya ki GIFT IFSC banking units ne $52.8 billion FCNR(B) swap, $11.62 billion ECB aur $11.12 billion bond listing ki hai. Foreign currency resources tezi se mobilise ho rahe hain.
items.who: Jo companies ya banks GIFT City IFSC mein operations karte hain, ya foreign currency financing dekh rahe hain unke liye hai.
items.action: Agar aapki company IFSC transactions mein involved hai to latest mobilisation numbers par nazar rakhein. Agar fund raising plan hai to GIFT City opportunities check karein.
